@@U04729@@
How swiftly then the foot that slips slides to its destruction. Fervent glances, flattering lips, lead to heart’s seduction.

@@U04730@@
(The MATER GLORIOSA soars into view.)

@@U04732@@
You who rise soaring to regions eternal, hear our imploring, great vision supernal, you without rival, give us your grace!

@@U04734@@
By my love that bent in weeping over your son, divinely born, wetting His feet with tears of balsam despite all Pharisaic scorn; by that jar that poured in reverence precious ointment so profusely, by my hair that dried those sacred limbs, that fell around them loosely—

@@U04736@@
By that well, that ancient station where Father Abram’s flocks were led; by the pail that wet the parched lips
translation:
@@U04729@@
那么，滑倒的脚会多么迅速地走向毁灭。热情的目光，谄媚的嘴唇，引发心灵的诱惑。

@@U04730@@
（荣耀女神号翱翔在视野中。）

@@U04732@@
你飞升到永恒的境界，聆听我们的恳求，超凡的伟大愿景，你无可匹敌，赐予我们你的恩典！

@@U04734@@
以我的爱，为你神圣诞生的儿子哭泣，尽管受到法利赛人的蔑视，仍用香脂的眼泪润湿他的脚；借着那罐子，倾注了如此多的珍贵的药膏，借着我的头发，干燥了那些神圣的肢体，松散地落在它们周围——

@@U04736@@
在那口井旁，那个古老的车站，亚伯兰神父的羊群被引导在那里；在润湿干燥嘴唇的桶旁
